# fw kernel

> Reference of the fw kernel command: The Linux kernel as pinned files: kernel.toml pins (mainline, stable, CachyOS) against kernel.org releases, shallow sparse…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/kernel/

The Linux kernel as pinned files: kernel.toml pins (mainline, stable, CachyOS) against kernel.org releases, shallow sparse submodule sync, UAPI types for bun:ffi, tree-sitter code graph (runs fw-linux)

## Usage

```bash
fw kernel <status|pin|sync|types|graph> [args]
```

## Aliases

`fw linux` runs `fw kernel`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw kernel status
fw kernel pin
fw kernel sync
fw kernel types
fw kernel graph
```

The names come from the usage line.
